scientific_integrity: Complete deterministic network-equilibrium theorem with full linear stability and a proved n-to-infinity star limit. Numeric verification is supplementary and is not a proof of all-size or all-real-exponent claims. Historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted complete bipartite networks, homogeneous parameters, fixed d>1, unnormalized neighbor power sum; local stability only. No stochastic dynamics, global basin calculation, degree-normalized model, general graph classification, or time-varying awareness.
title: Exact bipartite adoption folds and the vanishing hub threshold
